info.name: NotificationAPI REST In-App Inbox Users API

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user in your system.

items.docs: Creates or updates a user record with contact identifiers (email, number, push/web-push tokens, timezone, Slack channel). This request is authenticated with a per-user HMAC signature in the Authorization header (`Basic base64(clientId:userId:hmac)`) so it may also be called from trusted server contexts on behalf of a user.
